states.content: Non-emergency contact with Nadia Lopez must go only through Nadia directly (direct mobile 415-555-0191 first) and the patient portal, with the portal kept as the backup contact channel and nothing else; emergency channels may be used only in an emergency. The final call list shows Nadia's direct mobile and portal only as contact channels. Family is fully removed from her reminders and contact routing. The weekend check-in script will use Nadia's direct mobile only. Weekend billing notes route only to Nadia and not to family. River House must not reappear anywhere: the old River House backup line (415-555-0168) and the alias Mina have been deleted from shared notes and are excluded from all communications, forms and routing, with no fallback use; Nadia explicitly requests that the old backup route not be resurrected in any reminder. Deleted callback fragments were not restored in the nursing note, consistent with that request. Nadia does not want any work line or old shelter line used for contact; her contact note records that no work line and no deleted shelter line are to be used. Nadia wants this contact plan kept going forward. Her phone sometimes drops calls after 6 PM.

states.content: Nadia Lopez wants to be contacted only directly through herself and the patient portal from here forward, unless there is an emergency, and she wants this contact plan kept going forward. The portal is to be kept as the backup contact channel and nothing else. She does not want any work line or old shelter line used for contact. Family is fully removed from her reminders and contact routing. Her direct mobile 415-555-0191 remains confirmed and active as the primary route. River House must not reappear anywhere, including in communications, forms and routing; the old River House backup line (415-555-0168) and the alias Mina have been deleted from shared notes, the backup route is no longer to be used, and Nadia asks that it not be resurrected in any reminder. She asks that her callback route be kept private and considers the exact wording of the contact note important. She agrees that the transportation note (the transportation voucher sent to Nadia only) sounds right.
